# Sudan OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **7 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Sudan ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Sudan national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Sudan public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Sudan in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 11,029,000 |
| Lines / route length | 30 / 843 km |
| Fleet | 1,319 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $7.82 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $5.88 B (75%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 117.5 MW / 686.0 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $12.13 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
